name: Demand
title: Demand
text: 5. In the circumstances, I am instructed to call upon you, and I hereby call upon you, to {{notice_demand}}.

legal_basis.note: Compensation for loss or damage caused by breach of contract

authoring_note: The demand must be capable of being complied with. A demand that is vague, or that bundles a liquidated sum with an unquantified claim, gives the addressee an answer: that they did not know what to pay. Where a sum is claimed it should be stated as a figure with its computation, and any interest claimed should state the rate and the period.
